newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhenhai says current debt 791 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Zhenhai says current debt 791 mln yuan.

text.p: Zhenhai Refining & Chemical Co Ltd said on Monday its short-term debt and current maturities of long-term debt amounted to 791.46 million yuan, and long-term debt was 359.79 million yuan as at September 30.
The company said its total capitalisation was 5.23 billion yuan as at September 30.
Unaudited consolidated net assets were valued at 4.87 billion yuan, total current liabilities amounted to 1.53 billion yuan, and cash on hand was at 822.85 million yuan as at June 30, 1996, it said.
The company said it provides the information in respect of the proposed issue of US$200 million convertible bonds.
In October, Zhenhai Refining had said it would issue US$200 million of bonds convertible into the company's H shares, aiming at raising capital to finance its expansion programme.
The company had said Altantic Richfield Co (ACRO) and its subsidiary -- ARCO Asia Pacific Investments Ltd had agreed to subscribe a substantial portion of the bonds.
